from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Real-World Application: The Speedometer", [
            "A car's speedometer shows your speed at every heartbeat.",
            "It continuously calculates the derivative of your position.",
            "Calculus connects abstract math to our everyday movement."
        ])

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        
        # Build the Speedometer
        # Outer Arc
        speedo_arc = Arc(
            radius=1.5, 
            start_angle=225 * DEGREES, 
            angle=-270 * DEGREES, 
            color=GRAY_A
        )
        
        # Ticks
        ticks = VGroup()
        for i in range(11):
            angle = (225 - i * 27) * DEGREES
            start = [np.cos(angle) * 1.35, np.sin(angle) * 1.35, 0]
            end = [np.cos(angle) * 1.5, np.sin(angle) * 1.5, 0]
            ticks.add(Line(start, end, color=GRAY_A, stroke_width=2))
        
        speedometer = VGroup(speedo_arc, ticks)
        # Use B3-E6 to keep gap (B021)

        center_point = speedometer.get_center()

        self.play(
            angle_tracker.animate.set_value(45), 
            Write(speedo_label),
            run_time=3,
            rate_func=slow_into
        )
        needle.clear_updaters()
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(GRAY),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE)
        )
        
        # Final visualization: Needle oscillates slightly to show "live movement"
        self.play(
            angle_tracker.animate.set_value(60),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.play(
            angle_tracker.animate.set_value(50),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        self.wait(2)
